Rent covers a subset of the country spine and most visa fees could not be verified, so the total is a FLOOR whenever `complete` is false, and `missing` names each component that could not be priced. The entry ROUTE is derived exactly from passport mobility data, so 'visa-free for this passport' is always answered even where no fee is. The destination must be in the PPP registry; some countries with a verified nomad-visa fee are reachable only through /api/visas.json.
